title: Turbo Circuit
author: cobanov
description: An arcade lap racer on four low-poly circuits, from a sunny park to a desert canyon, autumn woods and a snowy peak: three laps against three AI rivals with boost pads, curbs, flying cones and a best race and lap saved for every circuit.

controls.A: Accelerate (on "1" at the start: turbo start); menus: select
controls.D-pad: Steer; title: choose the circuit; menus: move
controls.START: Pause menu (resume, sound, music, quit to title)
